title: Jaw Crusher

introduction.definition: A jaw crusher breaks rock by compression between a fixed jaw and a moving (swing) jaw. In the single-toggle design the swing jaw hangs on an eccentric shaft at the top and is supported at the bottom by a toggle plate. As the shaft turns, the jaw moves towards and away from the fixed jaw with an elliptical motion. Rock is nipped, crushed and moves down the V-shaped chamber until it is small enough to pass the closed-side setting (CSS) at the bottom.
applications: Primary crushing of hard rock, ore and recycled concrete
key_points: Compression crushing in a V-shaped chamber
Product size set by the closed-side setting (CSS)
Toggle plate acts as a safety element
introduction.summary: A jaw crusher breaks rock between a fixed jaw and a swinging jaw. The eccentric shaft moves the top of the swing jaw in a small orbit while the toggle plate holds the bottom; the jaw squeezes and releases the rock, which breaks and falls lower into the narrowing chamber until it passes the closed-side setting.

working_principle.characteristic_curve: Capacity rises with CSS and speed (up to an optimum); product gradation becomes finer with smaller CSS.

wear.title: Jaw die wear zones
wear.description: The dies wear fastest in the lower third, near the closed-side setting, where the gap is tightest and most of the crushing work is done (purple). Wear there opens the setting and makes the product coarser, so the setting is re-adjusted with shims or wedges. Many dies are symmetrical and can be turned top-to-bottom once to use the less-worn upper part.

foundation: Mount on a massive reinforced-concrete foundation or steel structure designed for the crusher's dynamic loads (maker's load data); use anti-vibration mounts where specified.
Allow crane access and lay-down space for liner and wear-part changes.
alignment: Align motor and crusher sheaves or coupling; set V-belt tension to the maker's figure.
Set the closed-side setting (CSS) or gap with the maker's gauge/lead-ball method.
piping: Feed with a controlled feeder (choke or regulated feed as designed); avoid segregated or one-sided feed.
Fit a tramp-metal magnet or metal detector ahead of the crusher and dust extraction at transfer points.
Lubrication system: connect oil supply/return, cooler and filter; check flow and pressure switches.
commissioning: Check lubrication flows and temperatures before starting; run empty to check direction, vibration and current.
Introduce feed gradually; measure product size and adjust the setting; record power draw as a baseline.

routine.task: Check for bridging, unusual noise and oil/grease temperatures.

periodic.task: Measure CSS and jaw-die wear; re-set the setting.

overhaul.task: Turn or replace jaw dies; replace toggle plate and seats; replace eccentric bearings.

lubrication: Eccentric shaft bearings: grease or circulating oil to the maker's schedule.

symptoms: Crusher stops crushing, jaw hangs back
causes: Uncrushable tramp metal (designed safety failure), fatigue
remedies: Remove tramp; replace toggle; improve tramp removal

safety: Lock out and block the flywheels before entering the chamber; beware of rock falling or being ejected.
Never clear a blocked crusher by hand or with the drive running.

video_tutorials.title: Jaw Crusher — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Jaw Crusher.
Check for bridging, unusual noise and oil/grease temperatures.
Measure CSS and jaw-die wear; re-set the setting.
Turn or replace jaw dies; replace toggle plate and seats; replace eccentric bearings.
Watch for toggle plate breakage: crusher stops crushing, jaw hangs back. Common cause: uncrushable tramp metal (designed safety failure), fatigue.
Watch for product too coarse: oversize in product. Common cause: worn dies, css opened.
Watch for bearing overheating: high temperature. Common cause: lubrication fault, overload.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
